# OR Operator

The OR operator `||` checks whether at least one condition is true. Use `||` when your app should do something if one condition or another condition is true.
name: OR Operator
tips:
- Use `||` between two Boolean values or conditions.
- Only one side of `||` needs to be true for the whole condition to be true.
- Put each comparison on its own side, like `score > 10 || hasBonus === true`.
- Do not use `||` when both conditions need to be true.
- In Web Lab, `||` is often used to check multiple possible choices or app states before updating the page.
